content:
Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: Working with Tables and Joins (INNER, OUTER)
    - Lesson 4: Conditional Queries with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 5: Data Manipulation using UPDATE and DELETE
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to SQL Aggregate Functions
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 8: Using Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 9: Understanding and writing JOIN types (CARTESIAN, SELF)
    - Lesson 10: Data Security with SQL

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Basics of Python (Variables, Functions, Control Structures)
    - Lesson 2: Introduction to Libraries (NumPy and Pandas)
    - Lesson 3: Handling Datasets using Pandas DataFrame
    - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning with Pandas (Handling Missing Values & Outliers)
    - Lesson 5: Data Exploration (Descriptive Statistics, Visualizations)
    - Lesson 6: Data Manipulation and Merging DataFrames
    - Lesson 7: Intro to Data Wrangling with Pandas Functions
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Data Visualization using Matplotlib

   Track: Intermediate SQL
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Joins (Left, Right, Full Outer)
    - Lesson 2: Using UNION and INTERSECT Clauses
    - Lesson 3: Working with Null Values in SQL
    - Lesson 4: Transactions & ACID Properties of SQL
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Stored Procedures
    - Lesson 6: Data Normalization for Relational Databases
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Aggregations (Count Distinct, Min/Max)
    - Lesson 8: Views and Indexes in SQL

   Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Regular Expressions with Re Library
    - Lesson 2: Reading and Writing Files using Context Managers
    - Lesson 3: Advanced Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 4: Merging and Aligning DataFrames effectively
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Time Series Analysis (Pandas DatetimeIndex)
    - Lesson 6: Grouping Data by Multiple Columns in Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Pivoting Data with Multi-level Indexes
    - Lesson 8: Building and Evaluating Machine Learning Models using Scikit-learn
